header.subtitle: World Football Atlas
hero.description: A complete encyclopaedia and scientific ranking of every documented football rivalry in the world. Transparent data, verified sources, open methodology.
hero.datanotice: Data collected over 50 seasons: 1975/76 – 2025/26. Opta snapshot: September 2025. Sources: Wikipedia, Wikidata, Transfermarkt.
encyclopaedia.title: Encyclopaedia
encyclopaedia.desc: All football rivalries documented on Wikipedia — organised by continent, nation, and type.
filter.empty: No rivalries found for the selected filters.
ranking.title: Ranking
ranking.desc: Scientific ranking of all rivalries in Opta-classified leagues. Transparent formula with adjustable parameters.
formula.label: The Formula
sliders.title: Formula Weights
sliders.note: Weights are automatically normalised to 1. The ranking recalculates in real time.
slider.l.name: League Prestige
slider.l.desc: Position in the global Opta ranking. More competitive leagues carry more weight.
slider.p.name: Historical Precedents
slider.p.desc: Total number of documented head-to-head matches in history.
slider.m.name: Longevity
slider.m.desc: Consecutive decades with at least one documented head-to-head match.
map.title: Map
map.desc: Stadiums of all clubs mentioned in rivalries. Click a marker for details.
charts.title: Charts
charts.desc: Original visualisations to read the data in new ways.
chart.treemap.title: Rivalry Weight Map
chart.timeline.title: Historical Timeline (Top 20)
chart.sunburst.title: League Hierarchy
chart.radar.title: Rivalry Comparison
chart.leagues.title: Rivalries by League
chart.leagues.desc: The leagues with the most rivalries in the ranking.
about.title: Method
about.desc: Full transparency: every data point is verified, every formula is open, every source is cited.
about.scope.title: Data Coverage
about.scope.desc: The encyclopaedia collects all rivalries documented on Wikipedia. The ranking considers rivalries between clubs in leagues classified in the complete Opta global ranking.
about.formula.title: The Formula in Detail
about.limits.title: Conscious Limitations
about.limits.fillrate: Stadium attendance data (1976-2026) is not included: global coverage is not sufficiently uniform to guarantee scientific rigour.
about.limits.opta: The Opta ranking is dynamic; this site uses a fixed snapshot (September 2025). It does not update automatically.
about.limits.headtohead: Head-to-head data comes primarily from Wikipedia: less-documented historical competitions may have incomplete counts.
about.sources.title: Full Sources
about.credits.title: Credits & Project
about.credits.desc: Open source project. Design inspired by Italian 1920s Futurism (Fortunato Depero, F.T. Marinetti). All data comes from public sources and is fully reproducible.
